subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should Discord get an opt-in autoThread follow-up mention gate, and should its public API be a Slack-style thread.requireExplicitMention option or a per-channel requireMentionInThreadReplies option?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public Discord config surface and changes which thread replies reach the agent, so automation should not choose the permanent API/default semantics on its own.

options.title: Add default-off explicit thread gate
options.body: Introduce an opt-in Discord thread policy that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

options.title: Fold into parent/thread override
options.body: Make the broader Discord parent-versus-thread requireMention design cover both directions and explicitly decide bot-owned autoThread precedence.

options.title: Keep current continuation
options.body: Decline new Discord config surface and document that bot-owned autoThreads intentionally continue without mentions.

recommendation.title: Add default-off explicit thread gate
recommendation.body: Introduce an opt-in Discord thread policy that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on shared mention gating and Discord preflight routing, and this choice crosses channel policy plus config compatibility.
